default.notes: Pre-arranged tourist eVisa required, obtained through an airline, hotel or UAE-based sponsor before travel.

groups.notes: GCC citizens may enter the UAE freely under Gulf Cooperation Council arrangements — a national ID card is accepted and no visa is needed.
Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period under the EU–UAE visa waiver.
Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period, on the same terms as EU citizens.
Visa-free under a bilateral agreement, commonly reported as up to 90 days in any 180-day period — confirm on icp.gov.ae before a long stay.
Visa-free for up to 30 days under a bilateral visa-exemption agreement.
Free 30-day visa on arrival, stamped at the border; extendable once from inside the UAE for a fee.

AE.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Emirati citizens.

IL.notes: Visa-free under the UAE–Israel visa-waiver agreement that followed the 2020 normalisation accords — commonly reported as up to 90 days; confirm current arrangements before travel.
